comparison.objective: Lift and hang a cabinet on a French cleat; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Level two-sided lifting and simultaneous cleat engagement versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, controlled hammer impact, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Cabinet released while level and wedged along the cleat, without tipping versus four notch fractures and total debris containment with hardware retained.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual coordination and damage avoidance, but large-body alignment and latching do not test impact fracture or fragment collection. No separate spec versions were provided.
